meta.source: CMS Physician Fee Schedule / CPT Editorial Panel
meta.scope: Baseline rules only. Payer-specific overrides live in vectordb (BCBS PDF).

logic_types.hard_stop: Do not submit. Claim will be denied. Requires correction before billing.
logic_types.documentation_gap: Submission allowed but flag for human review. Add 'Citations Needed' note.
logic_types.modifier_required: Claim will deny without correct modifier. Auto-apply if condition is met.
logic_types.informational: Low-risk note for coder awareness. No action required.

99396.description: Preventive medicine visit, established patient, age 40-64

common_modifiers.description: Significant, separately identifiable E&M service same day
common_modifiers.condition: A separate problem-oriented E&M service is documented and medically necessary on the same date as the preventive visit
A procedure or service is distinct and independent from other services performed on the same day, specifically when depression screening (96127) is billed more than once

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed more than once per calendar year for same patient
denial_triggers.action: Remove duplicate. Only one preventive visit per year is reimbursable under CMS.

denial_triggers.trigger: Patient age does not fall within 40-64 range
denial_triggers.action: Use 99395 for ages 18-39 or 99397 for ages 65+. Verify patient DOB from FHIR demographics.

denial_triggers.trigger: Patient listed as new patient — should be 99386 for new patients age 40-64
denial_triggers.action: Confirm established vs new patient status from FHIR encounter history.

denial_triggers.trigger: Documentation does not reflect comprehensive preventive exam
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. Clinical note must evidence comprehensive history, physical exam, and counseling/anticipatory guidance.

denial_triggers.trigger: Depression screening (96127) billed twice on same date without modifier 59
denial_triggers.action: Auto-apply modifier 59 to second 96127 instance. Cite BCBS Modifier 59 Policy if payer is BCBS.

99396.notes: Primary code for Tamera's encounter. Age 42, established patient, BCBS. Expect 96127 x2 — modifier 59 required.

90686.description: Influenza virus vaccine, quadrivalent (IIV4), preservative free, 0.5mL dosage, for intramuscular use

common_modifiers.description: Nurse midwife / alternate provider — rarely needed
common_modifiers.condition: Vaccine administered by non-physician provider in specific payer contexts

denial_triggers.trigger: Vaccine administration code (90471) not billed alongside 90686
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. 90471 (first vaccine admin) must accompany 90686. Without it, reimbursement for administration is lost.

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed more than once in same influenza season
denial_triggers.action: Remove duplicate. One influenza vaccine per season unless documented medical necessity.

denial_triggers.trigger: Wrong vaccine code for patient age or dosage
denial_triggers.action: Verify dosage from clinical note. 90685 is for 0.5mL preservative-free alternative. Confirm exact product administered.

90686.notes: Tamera received influenza seasonal injectable preservative free. Maps to 90686. Must pair with 90471.

90714.description: Tetanus and diphtheria toxoids (Td), preservative free, when administered to individuals 7 years or older, for intramuscular use

denial_triggers.trigger: Td booster administered less than 10 years after prior Td or Tdap
denial_triggers.action: Verify immunization history in FHIR immunization resource. CMS denies boosters given too early unless wound prophylaxis is documented.

denial_triggers.trigger: Vaccine administration code (90472) not billed for second vaccine on same date
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. When 90714 is billed same day as 90686, use 90472 (each additional vaccine admin) not 90471 again.

denial_triggers.trigger: Confused with 90715 (Tdap) — different indication and code
denial_triggers.action: Confirm from clinical note: Td (no pertussis) = 90714. Tdap (with pertussis) = 90715. Tamera's note says td (adult) — maps to 90714.

90714.notes: Tamera received td (adult) 5 lf tetanus toxoid preservative free. Maps to 90714. Must use 90472 since 90686 also billed same date.

99420.description: Administration and interpretation of health risk assessment instrument

denial_triggers.trigger: Not separately reimbursable by all payers — bundled into 99396 by some payers
denial_triggers.action: Check payer-specific policy before billing. BCBS may bundle 99420 into the preventive visit. Query vectordb for BCBS preventive bundling policy.

denial_triggers.trigger: No documented health risk assessment instrument in clinical note
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. Must reference a validated tool (e.g., PHQ-2, health risk appraisal). Tamera's note references PHQ-2 — sufficient if linked.

99420.notes: Tamera's note documents PHQ-2 administration. Supports 99420 but verify BCBS bundling policy via vectordb before submitting.

96127.description: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment with scoring and documentation

common_modifiers.condition: 96127 is billed more than once on the same date of service

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed more than once on same date without modifier 59 on second unit
denial_triggers.action: Auto-apply modifier 59 to second instance of 96127. Tamera's note documents depression screening x2 — this trigger is expected to fire.

denial_triggers.trigger: No scoring documentation in clinical note
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. PHQ-2 score must be recorded. Tamera's note lists PHQ-2 [reported] — verify score is captured.

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed without a corresponding preventive or E&M code
denial_triggers.action: 96127 is typically an add-on to a primary E&M or preventive visit. Confirm 99396 is present on the same claim.

96127.notes: Key code for the Modifier 59 demo. Tamera has depression screening x2 on same date. Second instance requires modifier 59. This is the centerpiece denial predictor scenario.

90471.description: Immunization administration; 1 vaccine (single or combination vaccine/toxoid)

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed more than once on the same date
denial_triggers.action: 90471 covers the FIRST vaccine only. Use 90472 for each additional vaccine administered on the same date. Remove duplicate 90471.

denial_triggers.trigger: No corresponding vaccine code (e.g. 90686, 90714) billed on the same claim
denial_triggers.action: Administration code requires a paired vaccine product code. Verify the vaccine CPT code is present on the claim.

90471.notes: First vaccine administration code. Always paired with the vaccine product code (e.g. 90686). Use 90472 for each additional vaccine on the same date.

90472.description: Immunization administration; each additional vaccine (single or combination vaccine/toxoid)

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed without a corresponding 90471 on the same claim
denial_triggers.action: 90472 is an add-on to 90471. Cannot be billed without 90471 present on the same claim.

denial_triggers.trigger: Number of 90472 units exceeds number of additional vaccines administered
denial_triggers.action: Bill one unit of 90472 per additional vaccine beyond the first. Verify vaccine count from clinical note.

90472.notes: Each additional vaccine administration beyond the first. Bill once per additional vaccine product code.

99408.description: Alcohol and/or substance abuse structured screening and brief intervention, 15-30 minutes

denial_triggers.trigger: Screening duration less than 15 minutes
denial_triggers.action: 99408 requires 15-30 minutes. Use 99407 for screenings over 30 minutes. Verify time documented in clinical note.

denial_triggers.trigger: No validated screening instrument documented (e.g. AUDIT, DAST, CAGE)
denial_triggers.action: Flag for human review. Clinical note must reference a validated substance abuse screening tool. DAST-10 is sufficient.

denial_triggers.trigger: Billed on same claim as 99420 for same screening
denial_triggers.action: 99408 and 99420 cannot be billed for the same screening instrument. 99408 is the correct code for DAST-10. Remove 99420 if present.

99408.notes: Correct code for DAST-10 substance abuse screening 15-30 min. Distinct from 96127 (brief behavioral assessment). Both can appear on the same claim when both screenings are documented.
